question: Which top-level packaging containers, meaning those not contained within any other packaging, have any item for which the total quantity accumulated across all nested levels in the hierarchy exceeds 500, and what are the names of both these containers and the corresponding items?
sql:
-- Let me verify the results and get the top-level container names too.
-- Results show:
-- Pallet of L (531) has Bottle 500cl with total qty 864 > 500
-- Pallet of M (532) has Bottle 330cl with total qty 720 > 500
-- Pallet Mix MS (533) has Bottle 500cl with total qty 600 > 500
-- Pallet Mix SG (534) has Bottle 500cl with total qty 856 > 500
-- 
-- Let me also verify my math for 534:
-- 534 -> 523 (x20) -> 502 (x30) => 20*30 = 600
-- 534 -> 524 (x16) -> 511 (x8) -> 501 (x3) => 16*8*3 = 384
-- 534 -> 524 (x16) -> 511 (x8) -> 502 (x2) => 16*8*2 = 256
-- Total Bottle 500cl in 534 = 600 + 256 = 856 ✓
-- Total Bottle 330cl in 534 = 384 (not > 500, so excluded) ✓

-- Now let me get the final answer with container names and item names
WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS cumulative_qty
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (
        SELECT id FROM packaging 
        WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations)
    )
    
    UNION ALL
    
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
)
SELECT 
    p_root.name AS container_name,
    p_leaf.name AS item_name,
    SUM(pt.cumulative_qty) AS total_qty
FROM packaging_tree pt
JOIN packaging p_root ON p_root.id = pt.root_id
JOIN packaging p_leaf ON p_leaf.id = pt.current_id
WHERE p_leaf.id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT packaging_id FROM packaging_relations)
GROUP BY p_root.name, p_leaf.name
HAVING SUM(pt.cumulative_qty) > 500
ORDER BY p_root.name, p_leaf.name

-- Now I need to compute, for each top-level container, the total quantity of each leaf item
-- that flows through it across all nested levels.
-- 
-- The hierarchy:
-- 531 -> 521 (x12) -> 502 (x72) => 502 qty = 12*72 = 864
-- 532 -> 522 (x20) -> 501 (x36) => 501 qty = 20*36 = 720
-- 533 -> 522 (x10) -> 501 (x36) => 501 qty = 10*36 = 360
-- 533 -> 523 (x20) -> 502 (x30) => 502 qty = 20*30 = 600
-- 534 -> 523 (x20) -> 502 (x30) => 502 qty = 20*30 = 600
-- 534 -> 524 (x16) -> 511 (x8) -> 501 (x3) AND 511 -> 502 (x2)
--   => 501 qty = 16*8*3 = 384
--   => 502 qty = 16*8*2 = 256
--
-- So for each top-level container and each leaf item, I need to compute the accumulated quantity.
-- Then filter those where total > 500.
--
-- I'll use a recursive CTE to traverse the hierarchy.

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    -- Base: direct children of top-level containers
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS cumulative_qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (SELECT id FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations))
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go deeper
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
)

    root_id,
    leaf_id,

FROM packaging_tree
GROUP BY root_id, leaf_id

-- Leaf items are Bottle 330cl (501) and Bottle 500cl (502).
-- Now I need to compute, for each top-level container, the total quantity of each leaf item
-- that flows through it across all nested levels.
-- 
-- The hierarchy:
-- 531 -> 521 (x12) -> 502 (x72) => 502 qty = 12*72 = 864
-- 532 -> 522 (x20) -> 501 (x36) => 501 qty = 20*36 = 720
-- 533 -> 522 (x10) -> 501 (x36) => 501 qty = 10*36 = 360
-- 533 -> 523 (x20) -> 502 (x30) => 502 qty = 20*30 = 600
-- 534 -> 523 (x20) -> 502 (x30) => 502 qty = 20*30 = 600
-- 534 -> 524 (x16) -> 511 (x8) -> 501 (x3) AND 511 -> 502 (x2)
--   => 501 qty = 16*8*3 = 384
--   => 502 qty = 16*8*2 = 256
--
-- So for each top-level container and each leaf item, I need to compute the accumulated quantity.
-- Then filter those where total > 500.
--
-- I'll use a recursive CTE to traverse the hierarchy.

WITH RECURSIVE packaging_tree AS (
    -- Base: direct children of top-level containers
    SELECT 
        pr.packaging_id AS root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pr.qty AS cumulative_qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging_relations pr
    WHERE pr.packaging_id IN (SELECT id FROM packaging WHERE id NOT IN (SELECT DISTINCT contains_id FROM packaging_relations))
    
    UNION ALL
    
    -- Recursive: go deeper
    SELECT 
        pt.root_id,
        pr.contains_id AS current_id,
        pt.cumulative_qty * pr.qty,
        pr.contains_id AS leaf_id
    FROM packaging_tree pt
    JOIN packaging_relations pr ON pr.packaging_id = pt.current_id
)
SELECT 
    root_id,
    leaf_id,
    SUM(cumulative_qty) AS total_qty
FROM packaging_tree
GROUP BY root_id, leaf_id
ORDER BY root_id, leaf_id
